requirements.REF_EN_request: Follows independent guard_ok, not reference_valid or QUAL_OK; avoids a circular start condition.
requirements.guard_ok: Independent supply/window authority with power valid before use. No implemented source.
requirements.reference_valid: Externally established settled/bounded reference under actual supply/slew/load; not inferred from elapsed time.
requirements.request_model: All health inputs must be present/true before qualification. Timing conflicts invalidate a trace; Boolean priority is not an analog proof.
requirements.fault_path: Fast inhibit plus fault memory plus physical output-disable boundary are distinct obligations.
requirements.island: Proposed reverse-blocked monitor supply for reference/comparator/retention/conditioner; main-rail sensing stays upstream. This does not power or validate existing U14 through brownout.
requirements.output_boundary: Must prevent invalid U14 from sourcing translator OE. Do not add a clamp against push-pull U14. Final series/enable isolation must be specified before native insertion.
requirements.shutdown: Independent guard requests REF_EN low and output isolation, while retained state remains powered until verified isolation completes. Reference injection paths still need bounds.
requirements.startup: Begin output-isolated; independently validate island and reference, then require a fresh healthy interval and deliberate ACK with ARM low.
requirements.hold_up: Effective capacitance, ESR, total load, reverse leakage and 100 us isolation deadline are unverified allocations; no fault source may drain the island outside the budget.
requirements.OV: Reverse blocking alone does not reject input overvoltage; island voltage ceiling and every pin/interface limit still need an explicit protection path.
requirements.off_state: A finite hold-up result ends at 3.005 V. It proves nothing afterward; an independently valid disabled output condition must already exist.
requirements.release: The 1 ms healthy interval is a policy allocation after reference_valid, not a reference startup guarantee.
requirements.island_floor: 3.005 V is the inherited reference sourcing-test floor, not a guarantee for unselected island parts. The charge screen assumes every island element remains valid down to this floor; use the maximum applicable floor across guard, retention, conditioner and interfaces when selecting parts. A higher floor reduces margin.
requirements.fast_boundary: Before main logic leaves its applicable supply range, the physical output boundary must suppress invalid U14 drive and then maintain disable continuously. The 100 us isolation-completion allocation is a handover-finish budget, not permission for undefined OE or a substitute for the fast end-to-end inhibit deadline.
requirements.excluded_pulse_checks: The request sequencer checks only listed guard intervals. It does not validate ACK high/low pulse widths, debounce, analog edge rates or asynchronous pulse capture.

next_scope: Close the physical permission boundary between U14 and TXU0102 OE, with exact partial-power, output-contention, disable-delay and powered-off leakage conditions; then resolve island isolation/charge/OV paths on a fresh native copy.
